context: Resume circa 2012 — snapshot of IBM India career from July 2007 through early 2012 (Staff Software Engineer). Covers four IBM roles across Lotus Expeditor / LWI, includes full givebacks, awards, education, and publications section.
raw_text:
Dattatreya S Vellal
Email: dsvellal@gmail.com | Mobile: +91-99723-12693

Objective: To work in a competitive environment that effectively utilizes analytical, interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills to conceive and achieve goals.

=== SUMMARY / ROLES ===

March 2011 – Present (Staff Software Engineer): Developer for Natural Resources Center of Excellence. Writes middleware services in Java for a condition monitoring application at Industry Solutions, India Software Labs, IBM India Pvt. Ltd. Responsible for design, validation, development and testing.

December 2010 – March 2011 (Software Engineer): Lead and Worldwide contact for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer. Identified for technical and leadership skills; given position of worldwide contact and lead of Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer and Portlet container.

October 2008 – December 2010 (Associate Software Engineer): Developer and component owner for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit. Owned components, responsible for successful delivery of Lotus Expeditor Toolkit v6.2.1, v6.2.2 and v6.2.3 leading activities.

July 2007 – September 2008 (Associate Software Engineer): Developer for JAX-WS layer enablement on Lotus Expeditor and Light Weight Infrastructure. Built integration layer enabling LWI to support JAX-WS web services.

=== SKILLS ===
Languages: Java
Web: Web Services, SOAP, XML, Servlets
Databases: DB2
Tools/Products: RAD, RSA, WID, Eclipse, IID, SOAPUI, Lotus Expeditor & Toolkit, Lotus Notes, Lotus Sametime, IBM Smart Cloud for Social Business, WPS, WAS

=== PROJECTS ===

Natural Resource Center of Excellence – Advanced Condition Monitoring for High Value Assets (March 2011 – Present)
Roles: UI Development Lead, Developer – Integration Services, Source Code Administrator, RTC/Community Maintainer, VM owner/maintainer, Scrum Master, Collaterals owner/creator.
Details: ACM for High Value Assets offers a single application leveraging real-time operational data from process control systems, engineering systems, and contextual business information to detect anomaly failure symptoms and initiate corrective actions.
Key contributions:
- Responsible for middleware services components; writes integration services and information management services
- Owns India Software Labs Natural Resources CoE community
- Creator/owner of team area managing tasks, stories, epics for agile delivery
- Collaborates with Natural Resources teams in Australia and Ireland
- Collaborated with Integrated Information Core team to reuse architectures
- Collaborated with Eclipse team in India on RTC setup/usage
- Collaborated with India Software Labs Tech-support team for VM setup
- Led IP mining sessions: 3 patent disclosures, 5 internal conference abstracts, 2 internship ideas
- Trained external resources; delivered sessions on IIC
- Co-authored poster on Condition Monitoring for Regional Technical Exchange 2011

Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer Development/Test (December 2010 – March 2011)
Role: Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer world-wide lead
Key contributions:
- Led team as worldwide lead; responsible for complete product ownership
- Solved 2 critical Sev 1 customer issues
- Brought defect count to virtual zero (no Sev 1 or Sev 2)
- Lead developer for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit; Scrum Master for several iterations
- Led Webcontainer feature implementation discussion with Lotus Domino Server team
- Responsible for promoting adoption into Lotus Domino Server and XPages
- Trained L3 resource; conducted training sessions on LotusLive and Lotus Connections
- Interacted with Sametime, Notes, Connections and LWI teams on Severity 1 defects

Lotus Expeditor Toolkit and Runtime development (October 2008 – December 2010)
Roles: Lead developer for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit; Developer for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer
Key contributions:
- Requirement analysis, planning, sizing, execution
- Implemented new features; fixed SPRs
- Wrote JUnit tests for Webcontainer; Accessibility Verification Testing for Toolkit
- Documented functionalities; point of contact for forums internally and externally
- Successful delivery of v6.2.1 and v6.2.2 Toolkit
- Hosted Lotus Expeditor kiosk at Eclipse Day 2010
- Represented Lotus Expeditor at Eclipse Helios launch Event 2010 and Lotus Users Group Bangalore 2010
- Developed PoC: Lotus Expeditor on mobile for life insurance customer
- Developed PoC: Lotus Expeditor on mobile to manage advertisement space in theaters
- Co-authored 3 DeveloperWorks articles: Introducing IBM LotusLive, LotusLive Engage, IBM Smart Cloud Meetings (translated to multiple languages)

JAXWS Layer for LWI 8.1.x (July 2007 – September 2008)
Role: Developer
Key contributions:
- Enabled/verified JAX-WS specification features on LWI
- Wrote JUnit tests; worked on LWI–WAS interoperability
- Wrote programming guide; interacted with FVT team; handled defects

=== GIVEBACKS ===

Publications:
- Patent published at USPTO: determining and conveying availability (filed 10 Dec 2010)
- Patent pending: Method for KPI Confidence Determination and Optimization
- Disclosure: Gesture based human identification protocol published in IP.COM on 29 Oct 2012
- Introducing IBM LotusLive, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Introducing IBM LotusLive Engage, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Introducing IBM SmartCloud Meetings, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Dattatreya S Vellal: Visual Component Dependency Management, R.V. College of Engineering, National Conference CCT-2010, 2010

Conferences / talks:
- Regional Technical Leadership Exchange 2010
- Regional Technical Exchange poster 2011
- Regional Technical Exchange poster 2012
- Talk via IBM University Relations on why IDEs should be adopted as programming platform in colleges
- Quality Software Engineering 2009 India level poster
- Talk on Design Patterns at National Seminar, New Horizon College of Engineering, 4 Nov 2011
- One-day workshop at Sir MVIT College of Engineering Bangalore on J2EE and advanced Java, 25 Feb 2012
- One-day workshop at GMIT Engineering College Davanagere on J2EE and advanced Java, 31 March 2012
- Half-day seminar on Web 2.0 at CMR-IMS Bangalore, 21 June 2012
- 1-hour web-session on IDEs via IBM University Relations / IBM India Technical Experts Council Tech-talk series to colleges across India

Events organized:
- Worldwide Bluehouse Event for Hackday 6 — Event Co-ordinator, 2008
- Hackday7 — India-wide Event Co-ordinator, Sessions Co-ordinator, 2009
- Lotus Knows 2009 — Bangalore Event Co-ordinator
- IBM Academy of Technology Annual General Body Meeting 2009, Bangalore — Event Co-ordinator
- India Regional Technical Leadership Exchange 2010 — Technical Core Agenda Team member / Event Co-ordinator
- Hackday8 — India-wide Event Co-ordinator/Lead, 2010
- India Regional Technical Exchange 2011 — IT and Technology core team member
- Hackday9 — Advisory council member, India-wide, 2011
- Hackday 10 — Advisory council member, India Software Labs Hackday X
- IBM University Relations 2011 Think-Explore-Evolve Challenge

Others:
- Leading internship project on 'Visual Project Dependency Management', 2008
- Active Computer Society of India member; seminars/workshops on J2EE, Eclipse, Web 2.0, Design Patterns
- LotusLive Meetings education demo, 19 April 2011
- Career Development Session to AIX Regression Testing team, 28 Sept 2011
- Scrum Master for 1H and 2H 2011 NR CoE team deliverables
- Contributed to IBM Blue Expression Toastmasters blog and newsletter
- Achieved 'Excellence in Leadership' award at District 82 meet in Sri Lanka, May 2012
- Mentoring toastmasters at Blue Expression Toastmasters Club (@Manyata) and Synergy Toastmasters Club (@EGL)
- Certified by SVYASA and Annamalai University to teach yoga

=== AWARDS AND RECOGNITIONS ===
- IBM Eminence and Excellence Award, Sept 30 2011 — outstanding contributions
- Mention in IBM Regional GMs monthly report for co-leading University Relations activity, July 2011
- Special mention in IBM University Relations newsletter, July 2011
- Recognized by VP of India Software Labs, 22 March 2011, for Hackday participation over three years
- IBM Inventor Award (July 2010) — first disclosure approved for filing at USPTO: 'Determining and Conveying Availability'
- Recognized at IBM Regional Technical Leadership Exchange 2010 as most influential Technical Experts Council Member of India
- 'Best Implementation' award for stretch assignment 'Micro-Insurance' at India Hackday 2010 Pune
- Bravo Award, October 2009 — personal dedication in organizing first Lotus Knows event
- Bravo Award 2009 — passion/dedication for Hackday6, Hackday7, Worldwide Bluehouse Hackday, Lotus Knows, Manyata Fun Day
- Bravo Award, June 2008 — leadership in completing internship project 'Visual Composition Editor for Generating Composite Services'
- Multiple IBM Thanks Awards for contributions outside scope of work
- Toastmasters International: Competent Communicator and Competent Leader certifications

=== EDUCATION ===
- R. V. College of Engineering, Bangalore — B.E. Computer Science (79.2%), 2007
- Annamalai University, Chidambaram — Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (76%), 2010
- Annamalai University, Chidambaram — Master of Science in Yoga (76.6%), 2011

=== TRAININGS ===
Assertive Skills, Presentation Skills, Communication Skills, Time Management Skills, Emerging Technical Leadership Lab

=== INTERESTS ===
Technology, Story Telling, Indian Mythology, Indian Epics, Yoga, Photography
